title: What is the duration of an ABA therapy session?
metaTitle: ABA Therapy Session Duration - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the duration of ABA therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network and how we tailor sessions to suit your child's individual needs for maximum benefit.
html: The length of an ABA therapy session at Pinnacle Blooms Network is uniquely tailored according to your child's specific requirements and their endurance. While industry standards suggest 20 to 50 hours per week, we ensure your child's comfort and needs are prioritized above all. Our goal is to create a balanced, engaging and productive session each time.
